en: Colorized military-themed postcard framed with painted flowers. At the top is a small monochrome drawing of a large rectangular military barracks complex labeled 'Caserne Landremont Nancy'. Below, in the main image, a French infantryman in dark blue tunic and red trousers stands holding a bouquet of flowers, surrounded by floral decorations. In the lower right, a white card bears the printed words 'Souvenir du 37e d'Infanterie'. A red French postage stamp marked 'République Française Postes' is affixed at the lower left.
